about: The installation each release track ships to, read by the release train's installation gate (tool/release_gate.dart) before any upload. No release build passes a server of its own, so every track ships to the server the app compiles in: the hosted reference installation. A track that ships elsewhere changes its entry here and the build that targets it in the same change; test/tool/release_gate_test.dart holds the two together. The key is the publishable one the app ships.
